description: Break down one range session: Swing Score, its areas and skill scores when the app synced them, plus the median of each swing measurement (tempo, backswing/downswing time, hip turn, posture; shoulder turn, X-Factor and hand speed with Apple Watch; head stability with AirPods). For a focus session, how many focus swings landed in the zone vs before; What your swing shows (patterns) when the app synced them. Newer sessions report On target and every stat as "k of n in range" (Work on, Good, Watch) instead of a Swing Score; On target is relative to the golfer's own normal, never a comparison with anyone else. Defaults to the latest session. Only interpret what is returned; PocketCaddie does not measure ball flight, carry or club head speed.
